# 🐔Chained and Grained Update is HERE🐔
New Chain Mode Stage: "Cluck-back Canyon" is HERE!

This latest stage takes place on a peaceful, quiet countryside ranch... at least it was until the chickens staged a coup!

The flock has officially taken over!
Watch out! These birds will charge at you with blank stares and explode on impact!

It's total chaos out there, with eggs that send you flying and mushrooms that paralyze you if you touch them!

Do it for the animals who were kicked out! Work together with your chained partner to reclaim the ranch from the chicken army!
[media]

# 💪Your hands are crowbars—ready to start climbing💪
In Crowbar Climber, use your crowbars to make your way up!

Face hooks, planks, and gears using only your arms. Can you beat the game before you run out of energy?
[media]

# 🤝 Have a Blast with Friends in Multi-Mode 🤝
In addition to the multi-player Race Mode, you can also play Chain Mode, where two players are chained together and must cooperate to reach the top!
[media]

# 🎁 Dress Up in a Variety of Charming Skins 🎁
Customize the look of both your skin and your crowbar!

There are tons of "cool" and "funny" styles to choose from!
[media]

# 🧱 Conquer Unique and Chaotic Stages 🧱
We’ve prepared plenty of stages packed with various gimmicks!

Can you clear them all?
[media]

# 💬 Join the Discord!!
Check our Discord for the latest news, player interactions, free skin giveaways, and more!

https://mydearest.net/CrowbarClimber-BazookaDiscord
